description: Na₂S₂O₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted octahedral geometry to one S and five O atoms. The Na-S bond length is 3.01 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one S and four O atoms. The Na-S bond length is 3.04 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.40 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two S and four O atoms. There is one shorter (2.93 Å) and one longer (3.08 Å) Na-S bond length. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.52 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one S and six O atoms. The Na-S bond length is 2.94 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.94 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four S and three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.98-3.22 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.72 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three S and three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.78-3.01 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.43 Å. There are six inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one S and three O atoms. The S-S bond length is 2.04 Å. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.51 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one S and three O atoms. The S-S bond length is 2.03 Å. All S-O bond lengths are 1.49 Å. In the third S site, S is bonded to four Na and one S atom to form distorted SNa₄S trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three ONa₃S tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent SNa₄S trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃S tetrahedra. The S-S bond length is 2.02 Å. In the fourth S site, S is bonded to four Na and one S atom to form distorted SNa₄S trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₃S tetrahedra and corners with four SNa₄S trigonal bipyramids. In the fifth S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one S atom. In the sixth S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one S and three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.48 Å) and two longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one S atom to form distorted ONa₃S tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃S tetrahedra, corners with four SNa₄S trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SNa₄S trigonal bipyramid. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one S atom to form distorted ONa₃S tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃S tetrahedra and corners with three SNa₄S trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom.
